name: TOB WhatsApp Quick Reply
description: A short list of saved responses an admin can insert with one tap while replying in the WhatsApp inbox (Communication Center) — e.g. a welcome message or a prayer-request acknowledgement, so common replies don't need retyping. Admin-growable: add/delete directly from the WhatsApp conversation screen's quick-reply picker, no code deploy needed.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: Short label shown in the picker, e.g. "Welcome" — not sent itself.

fields.label: Reply Text
fields.description: The actual text inserted into the composer when picked.
